definitions: To be an unobserved witness to a private conversation or event.
To be present at an event without being noticed or influencing it.
examples: I would have loved to have been a fly on the wall during their secret meeting.
She wished she could have been a fly on the wall when the decision was made.
Imagine being a fly on the wall for that historic discussion.
lemma: be a fly on the wall
source: have been a fly on the wall
